name: Rhoda
background: A young servant in the household of Mary. She is earnest, perceptive, and loyal to the movement.

genericReactions.physical: Oh! I don't know what that is. I just keep the house in order.
genericReactions.testimonial: I only speak of what I saw with my own eyes. I wouldn't dare say more.
genericReactions.digital: Scrolls and records? That's for the masters of the house, not me.
genericReactions.environmental: The dust here? I try to keep it clean, but so many people come and go.
genericReactions.analytical: That's a lot of numbers. I'm not sure what it means.
genericReactions.prophecy: The prophets? My mother taught me the stories, but I never thought I'd see one.
